findings.description: The truthiness check `if fg:` drops the foreground color when fg is the integer 0 (256-color black), so style() silently emits no color code instead of 38;5;0. The same applies to `if bg:` at line 684 for background 0.
findings.rationale: Trigger: click.style(text, fg=0). Before this change, `fg is not None` was true and _interpret_color returned '38;5;0'. Now 0 is falsy, so no escape is added and the text is unstyled. Impact: users requesting color index 0 see uncolored output with no error, a silent wrong result.
